findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_feed, get_visibility, get_seo · Private data: whoami · Public sink: get_visibility, undo_move, set_loop_autonomy · Destructive: whoami, get_enrollment, get_snapshot, refresh_scan, replenish_feed, run_loop, set_loop_cadence, create_checkout, create_topup.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_feed, get_visibility, get_seo · Private data: whoami · Public sink: get_visibility, undo_move, set_loop_autonomy · Destructive: whoami, get_enrollment, get_snapshot, refresh_scan, replenish_feed, run_loop, set_loop_cadence, create_checkout, create_topup

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
